date_integrity: The 2003-10-23 date is explicitly recorded as the initial author date for OEIS A087459, a public index of the exact Pythagorean excess statistic. It is not inferred from a journal issue or from a later revision.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts only unordered primitive Pythagorean triangles with square integer inradius under hypotenuse cutoff; no claim on nonprimitive triangles or optimal discrepancy. Residual risk: an earlier unindexed hypotenuse-specific count may exist. The short Omland fixed-radius note and the O'Loughlin inradius note were not read in full; their available descriptions do not show hypotenuse-cutoff asymptotics.
title: A hypotenuse-counting law for primitive Pythagorean triangles of square inradius
